readerCopy.body: The institution points to the scale of its relief effort while recipients and workers describe help that is late, uneven, or impossible to access. One side cites money raised and people reached; the other points to the needs and communities that disappeared inside the totals. Jupiter holds the larger promise, while Neptune gives emotional power to the ideal the numbers are meant to represent. The opposition places public generosity across from the confusion and disappointment underneath it. The campaign may remain inspiring while the people closest to the work struggle to say where the promise failed.
